translations.web: In the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, the tabernacle was raised up.
translations.bsb: So the tabernacle was set up on the first day of the first month of the second year.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass in the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, that the tabernacle was reared up.
